ops.old: Soft pretzel bites dipped in a bicarb bath and baked deep brown, rolled in butter and cinnamon sugar, with a warm salted caramel dip. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g yeast, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 250ml warm water, knead and prove 1 hour. Roll into ropes, cut into 3cm bites and dip in 2 litres boiling water with 60g bicarb soda for 30 seconds. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Toss in 50g melted butter, then 80g caster sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Warm 150ml store-bought caramel sauce with a pinch of salt for dipping.
